title: The Art of Exorcism in Genshin Impact: How to Complete Trials and Defeat 50 Enemies
excerpt: Walkthrough of all levels of the Art of Exorcism challenge in Genshin Impact: which talismans to take to defeat 50 demons in each stage.
content:
Tactics for fighting against all demon lords.

The Art of Exorcism - A Danmaku Challenge Genshin Impact, where, armed with spiritual weapons and battle talismans, you'll confront unintelligent demons and powerful overlords. Aim precisely and fuse elements to strengthen them. Defeat all waves of normal and elite monsters to unlock the third room, which features a final enemy with a unique attack pattern.

To start a challenge, start an event "The Silver-winged Bird on its Way to the Moon" and talk to the exorcist's assistant Wen Xun in Port of Yilun in the quest "Kaleidoscope of Talismans".

Content

How to complete Art of Exorcism in Genshin Impact

In addition to combining spiritual weapons and searching for suitable combat talismans, danmaku requires actively moving the Traveler and monitoring their vitality.

  1. Change the cursor position and take advantage of projectile ricochets. Catch them in time to fire a new volley faster.
  2. Collect orbs in the arena: gilded spiritual power grants experience, green particles restore health, and diamond-shaped pieces unlock new battle talismans.
  3. If you get attacked by a monster or an enemy reaches the edge, you will lose some HP.

Path in the mist

Spiritual shells
  • Pyro-Electro - primary;
  • Hydro-Electro;
  • Anemo in combination with any element.
Combat Talismans
  • Burning и eruption best choice to strengthen the Pyro-Electro spiritual projectile.
  • If elite combat talismans do not drop, then strengthen the shots of spiritual projectiles through Hurricane fire, Escalation и Deadly accuracy.

For the "Path in the Mist" mission, prioritize the Pyro-Electro and Hydro-Electro combos: their powerful area-of-effect damage will help quickly dispatch waves. If you didn't get these at the start, don't worry—you'll get two extra slots (for a total of three).

The leader of all demons on this level is The color of liesHe moves around the field actively, which means you'll have to frequently move the cursor position. When he move to the center, prepare to dodge. Move through the safe zone in the chain of charges, continuing to strike back.

Poisonous Veil

Spiritual shells
  • Hydro-Pyro - primary;
  • Pyro-Electro;
  • Hydro-Electro
Combat Talismans
  • Shock fire и A furious explosion to increase the frequency of shots and area damage - this way you can miss your projectiles without losing effectiveness.
  • Any talismans that increase the Hydro, Electro, and Pyro effectiveness of the corresponding elemental projectiles.

The main difficulty of the "Poisonous Shroud" is the barrier that reflects spiritual projectiles: in order to maintain an active volley, you will have to constantly move around the arena and hit your "balls"If you don't do this, you will have a hard time dealing with it. an abundance of enemiesthat are heading towards you.

Hydro, paired with Electro and Pyro, will be the key element in the battle. This elemental combination will help maintain high HP and also provide good area-of-effect damage, which can be lacking as the field expands. The shielded Lie Blossom in the final room will die quickly, and reaching it is a difficult task due to the large number of normal enemies.
